mintAuthority.summary: DOLA's INV-governed 48-hour Timelock operator can raw-mint durable supply to any recipient without a posted-collateral check or numeric token cap. FiRM and the enabled PSM Fed have governance-raiseable issuance ceilings; the flash minter is limited and must repay and burn within one transaction. Frontier has no local numeric ceiling, but mints into a fixed cToken with borrowing paused and matching shares held by the Fed; chair-only unbounded chosen-recipient extraction is not established. The operator independently establishes aggregate unbounded economics, while incomplete process certificates and a positively traced voting-control failure prevent governance-process qualification. Immutability refers only to Ethereum DOLA bytecode, not minter membership or downstream administration.

mintIncidents.summary: The April 2022 Anchor lending-market oracle-manipulation exploit inflated INV collateral value, enabling DOLA borrowing and withdrawal from Anchor pools and leaving bad debt. It was not a demonstrated DOLA minter-key compromise or bypass of token mint authorization.

controls.label: DOLA token operator (Timelock, 48h delay)
controls.capDescription: The token has no hard mint cap. The operator can mint directly and authorize additional minters through its 48-hour Timelock; operational Fed issuance is a separate authorized path.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095807, DOLA.operator() returned 0x926df14a23be491164dcf93f4c468a50ef659d5b, whose admin() returned 0xbeccb6bb0aa4ab551966a7e4b97cec74bb359bf6 and delay() returned 172800 seconds. The issuer deployment source permits mint() from either the operator or an address whose minters mapping is true; burn() is permissionless for the caller's own balance.

controls.label: FiRM Fed authorized DOLA minter
controls.capDescription: Global supplyCeiling() is 100000000000000000000000000000 raw units (1e29), or 100 billion DOLA. Proposal 332 deprecated the restrictive global ceiling by setting this high value; the source still checks it and per-market ceilings. Expansion is chair-only into registered, non-borrow-paused markets within their ceilings. Only gov can change global and per-market ceilings, so the Timelock can raise them while the chair cannot.

controls.label: Frontier Fed authorized DOLA minter
controls.capDescription: Frontier expansion has no local numeric supply ceiling: the chair raw-mints DOLA into a fixed cToken and the Fed receives matching shares. Borrowing is paused, while cToken minting is not. Only the Timelock admin can unpause borrowing or reduce reserves. Outside shareholders can redeem finite existing claims; contraction burns principal and takeProfit pays only the fixed gov recipient. These facts do not establish chair-only unbounded chosen-recipient extraction or a collateral cap.

controls.label: PSM Fed authorized DOLA minter
controls.capDescription: The enabled PSM Fed has a 10 million DOLA supplyCap, raiseable only by governance, and chair-only expansion into its immutable PSM. At the fresh pin it had supplied 200,000 idle DOLA to that PSM, which held no USDS. This is capped issuance inventory, not funded holder-redemption capacity; the issuer-documented other Fed generation is not an enabled minter.

controls.label: DOLA atomic flash minter
controls.capDescription: maxFlashLimit() is 5000000000000000000000000 (5 million DOLA), and owner-only setMaxFlashLimit can raise it. The source retrieves and burns the minted amount before returning; this is atomic flash issuance, not durable unbacked supply.
controls.evidence: An Alchemy full-history AddMinter/RemoveMinter query through Ethereum block 26095807 returned 54 logs and 29 distinct candidates. Pinned native minters(address) checks identify this flash minter plus the three Feds as the four enabled minters. owner() is the operator Timelock, dola() is the native DOLA token, flashMinted() is zero and maxFlashLoan(DOLA) equals the 5 million DOLA limit. Verified source requires repayment and burns the flash-issued DOLA in the same transaction.

review.evidence: Historical review at Ethereum block 26097135 (2026-10-01T11:21:35Z) enumerated 54 AddMinter/RemoveMinter events and 29 candidates, confirming four enabled minters. operator() was 0x926df14a23be491164dcf93f4c468a50ef659d5b with delay() 172800 seconds; a read-only mint(operator,1e18) call as operator succeeded without collateral or a numeric token cap. Frontier chair expansion(1e18) deposited minted DOLA into its fixed cToken. FiRM's ceiling was 1e29 raw, PSM's cap 1e25 raw and flash maxFlashLimit 5e24 raw, with governance setters and mandatory atomic flash repayment/burn. The historical 2026-10-03 sweep at Ethereum block 26113566 (2026-10-03T18:20:11Z; hash 0x8ee5bf8702023bb24470045b03b62f22fe10f1c46654ea9e79377e5dac7193b9) confirmed Frontier's enabled mapping, Timelock gov, 2-of-6 chair Safe and uncapped fixed-cToken expansion, but did not certify complete Fed/chair/cToken/Comptroller execution reach. Fresh review at Ethereum block 26214783 (2026-10-17T20:51:59Z; hash 0xd8de05d65dd285a6482739aeee16a7ee5a9a492fb9d8a0f0edf784957f94caee) confirmed the same native minter census and operator. Source-reviewed mint(to,amount) and a read-only operator mint to a chosen outside recipient for 1e30 raw establish aggregate unbounded economics independently of Frontier; impersonating the authorized operator does not bypass its governance or delay. Frontier borrowing was paused at both the historical sweep and fresh pin; the Fed holds matching shares for fixed-market expansions, contraction burns principal, outside suppliers redeem finite claims and takeProfit pays fixed gov. Chair-only unbounded chosen-recipient extraction is not established, so the prior non-token-governor Safe/G1 accusation is withdrawn rather than replaced by a collateral-cap claim. Governance-process rungs remain denied because complete execution certificates and a typed authority graph are absent AND D32 positively fails: at block 26214783, independently verified at Ethereum block 26214981 (2026-10-17T21:31:47Z; hash 0x694cea66e87f898336b470261d904d40e4386b0abfd6895c39f67180a100119f), INVEscrow 0x53039ef2274f9bb4852632ecb48c6dd9ebf5edf5 has beneficiary Safe 0x495886947eace9788360f46be55c758f92ecd074, a separate 2-of-3 controller, while xINV.delegates(escrow) is EOA 0x3fcb35a1cbfb6007f9bc638d388958bc4550cb28, not one of its owners. Its 6412508715301415641032 raw xINV at exchangeRateCurrent 7829257361229428580 supplies approximately 50,205.18 INV-equivalent votes, exceeding quorumVotes() of 24,000. The caster is positively identified as Inverse Deployer and a Fed-chair Safe owner; the beneficiary Safe's ultimate beneficial ownership is not established. GovernorMills requires forVotes >= quorum and forVotes > againstVotes, so this is sufficient affirmative power absent sufficient opposition, not an unconditional majority. The beneficiary can revoke delegation, but revocable other-holder casting still fails D32; this finding is not inferred from zero direct balances or concentration alone. Reconciliation is reviewed not-applicable for this protocol-native CDP/delegated-Fed issuance mechanism rather than an off-chain issuer reserve-attestation workflow. Public Fed supply/globalSupply/supplies counters, market debt and expansion/contraction events provide on-chain accounting, not demonstrated recurring whole-native-supply-to-backing reconciliation including operator-direct issuance and bad debt. No continuous/periodic reconciliation or prudential/financial-attestation supervision credit is claimed. Ethereum DOLA bytecode immutability does not make operator/minter membership or downstream administration immutable. Aggregate economics and derived-consistent fallback remain unbounded and unbounded-adverse; the retained lending-oracle incident is historical and resolved, not an active minter compromise.
